verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.en_bbe: Then Bildad the Shuhite made answer and said,

verses.en: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.
verses.pt: Com Deus estão domínio e temor; ele faz reinar a paz nas suas alturas.
verses.en_web: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.
verses.en_bbe: Rule and power are his; he makes peace in his high places.

verses.en: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?
verses.pt: Acaso têm número os seus exércitos? E sobre quem não se levanta a sua luz?
verses.en_web: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?
verses.en_bbe: Is it possible for his armies to be numbered? and on whom is not his light shining?

verses.en: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
verses.pt: Como, pois, pode o homem ser justo diante de Deus, e como pode ser puro aquele que nasce da mulher?
verses.en_web: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?
verses.en_bbe: How then is it possible for man to be upright before God? or how may he be clean who is a son of woman?

verses.en: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
verses.pt: Eis que até a lua não tem brilho, e as estrelas não são puras aos olhos dele;
verses.en_web: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;
verses.en_bbe: See, even the moon is not bright, and the stars are not clean in his eyes:

verses.en: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?
verses.pt: quanto menos o homem, que é um verme, e o filho do homem, que é um vermezinho!
verses.en_web: How much less man, who is a worm, the son of man, who is a worm!”
verses.en_bbe: How much less man who is an insect, and the son of man who is a worm!
